conditional_authorization.scope: Conditional paired FP32 fit after both exact-update, finite-loss/GradStats, memory and projected-runtime gates pass.

delivery_correction.profile_projection: The post-profile elapsed duration already includes the two profile runs; projection adds only remaining fit/prediction work plus its 300-second estimate margin.
delivery_correction.provider_timing_scope: Kaggle queue/cold start before kernel-process entry and output transport after process exit are outside this packet watchdog and have no hard 6,000-second promise.
delivery_correction.regression_case: A spec timeout computed at t=200 from a 6000-second deadline is 5200; a worker launch at t=700 receives 5000 seconds.
delivery_correction.runner_watchdog: The spec is created during bootstrap, but preflight can consume time before Popen. The runner now recomputes the timeout at launch and persists the resolved value in the worker spec and timeout receipt.
delivery_correction.runtime_deadline: A 6,000-second kernel-process deadline starts at bootstrap entry; the recipe worker and runner timeout are reduced by actual bootstrap/preflight elapsed time while preserving a separate 300 seconds for runner finalization.
